arms.name: fixed
arms.initial_state: fixed vector from audited parent prepared state

primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE and termination status, retaining all evaluations and accepted states. Report best accepted separately.
capacity_gate: Unchanged 90% zero-start mean-response energy, eligible termination required.
history: Same fitted parameters; reset optimizer histories. Not independent initializations.
interpretation: Seed is an explicit objective change. Do not infer biological correctness or generalization from lower training loss.
endpoint_checks: input and backend source equality across arms except seed receipt
failure_policy: No retries, silent budget extensions, new dynamics or held-out scoring. Retain failures.
timing: Concurrent CPU runs allowed; no controlled speed comparison.
